units.attenuationSlope: dB/(cm MHz) for amplitude using 20 log10
units.spectrum: Relative Fourier amplitude (amplitude·us), arbitrary scale; integral over MHz yields relative amplitude
units.band: full width at half amplitude, -6.020599913279624 dB; not half power
units.powerSpectrum: Squared Fourier amplitude, not an absolute calibrated power density; frequency moments reported separately
units.noisePsd: Unit white analytic input PSD before the electronic receiver filter; arbitrary power/MHz

source.receiverSigmaDefinition: 1/sigmaR^2 = 1/sigmaOut^2 - 1/sigmaEcho^2; sigmaOut=c/(4*pi*0.26). Chosen generic benchmark, not measured calibration.

provenance.profileOperation: select exact stored indices; no normalization or synthesis
